steps.caption: Open Ask AI, then the Memory tab.
Inferred items are never treated as confirmed; items older than 180 days are flagged.
Your writing style: learnt only from messages you sent or approved. Rebuild or turn it off.
Filter by category (person, company, requirement, relationship) and status.
Statuses: Active, Restricted, Outdated (old versions), Forgotten.
Each memory: who it's about, where it came from, when captured, verified or not, review date.
Chips show confidence and warnings like 'Needs review' for old items.
Correct: Ananya's preference changed. Open Correct.
Write the new version and who told you.
Save correction. The old version is kept as history.
'Earlier versions' shows what it used to say.
Mark verified: you've checked Zentrix still needs CFO sign-off.
Restrict: a sensitive guess about Vikram. Restricted items are kept but used carefully.
Forget: the metro request is out of date. Tick 'Erase permanently' and press Forget.
Switch the status filter to All to see restricted and forgotten items too.
